title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
content: A Bitcoin Core contributor found that the wallet's habit of resending stuck payments lets anyone link an address to the computer watching it, for under 35 cents.

title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
content: More bitcoin is sitting untouched onchain as the price holds around $60,000, some 50% below its peak,

title: Spain moves to grant financial watchdog power to freeze crypto accounts
content: A new decree would allow Spain’s financial intelligence unit to suspend crypto accounts, with firms facing fines for noncompliance.

title: Crypto on notice as hawkish Fed risks December ‘meltdown’
content: Economist Robin Brooks warned of dire consequences for stocks if the Federal Reserve fails to deliver dovish cues before the FOMC blackout period.

title: BIS chief Pablo Hernández de Cos set to become next ECB president: FT
content: The Spanish economist has questioned the viability of stablecoins for widespread payments while backing the development of a digital euro.

title: How EU brokers could lose access to Kyrgyz crypto exchanges
content: A vote on Kyrgyzstan could make an exchange’s home country the deciding factor in whether a European broker can use it to settle a trade.

title: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
content: Nasdaq’s Roland Chai backed exploring common EU rules for tokenized securities and said its Swedish subsidiary had applied for a DLT license.

title: Before the Sell-Off, AI Stocks Showed Dot-Com-Level Bubble Signals: Study
content: A study of 170 years of financial journalism suggests AI stocks rivaled dot-com bubble levels, but estimates vary.

title: Bitcoin Holds Above $60K as Death Cross Clouds Thanksgiving Recovery
content: Bitcoin and major altcoins rose slightly on Thanksgiving, but a bearish death cross suggests crypto remains weaker than stocks.

title: Spain Lets Its Financial Intelligence Unit Freeze Crypto Accounts Without a Court Order
content: Sepblac can now suspend crypto, bank and payment accounts for up to five working days, with courts deciding on any extension.

title: OpenAI Fixes ChatGPT Billing Error, Promises to Make it 40% Worse
content: OpenAI says a billing mistake made its new AI models cheaper to use than intended. Subscribers will now burn through their allowances faster, but get a free one-time usage reset.

title: Elon Musk Says ‘Multiplanetary’ SpaceX Could Be Worth $118 Quintillion. Yes, Quintillion
content: The SpaceX founder claims the firm could one day be worth a million times the global economy, as he pledges free shares to American children.

title: The Agentic Economy Is WAY Bigger Than You Think | Xen Baynham-Herd

title: Bitcoin Has Become Boring, Finally

title: Bitcoin is Vanishing into “Deep Storage” Faster than Miners Make It
content: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin is Vanishing into “Deep Storage” Faster than Miners Make It Miners produce about 450 new Bitcoin a day, but over the past year about 630 a day moved into wallets dormant for 10 years.
